responsibility: Declares the SHORTREAL-to-string formatting interface that returns DynamicStrings in floating-point, engineering, and fixed-point forms. It is the short-precision front end of the gm2 ISO real-formatting subsystem, providing reusable renderers for higher-level modules such as ShortConv, ShortStr, and short-real I/O code while keeping the formatting results in dynamically managed string objects rather than fixed caller buffers.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public SHORTREAL formatting interface: it only declares the DynamicStrings-returning procedures that the companion ConvStringShort.mod implements by delegation.
